item.quantx.materializer_upgrade.desc: Right-click a previous-tier Materializer to upgrade it, keeping recipes and matter.
item.quantx.punch_card.desc: Shift+Right-click a Materializer to record or load recipes. Single use.
item.quantx.punch_card.transferred: Transferred %s recipe(s). The card degraded into %s
item.quantx.matter_gun.desc: Hold RMB on a block to dematerialize it into stored matter. Shift+Right-click a Materializer to transfer it.
item.quantx.matter_gun.empty: The gun's matter tank is empty
item.quantx.matter_gun.full: The gun's matter tank is full
item.quantx.matter_pack.desc: Worn in the slot to the left of the chestplate.
item.quantx.matter_pack.bonus: Expands the gun's tank by %s matter
advancement.quantx.root.title: QuantX
advancement.quantx.scan.title: Know Your Matter
advancement.quantx.scan.desc: Scan an item to learn its recipe
advancement.quantx.demat.title: Reduce to Dust
advancement.quantx.demat.desc: Dematerialize an item into raw matter
advancement.quantx.mat.title: Something from Nothing
advancement.quantx.mat.desc: Materialize a learned item from matter
advancement.quantx.card.title: Portable Knowledge
item.quantx.guide_book.desc: RMB — open the illustrated mod recipe guide.
guide.quantx.subtitle: Matter Field Guide
guide.quantx.cover.2: Hover a slot for the item tooltip
guide.quantx.cover.3: ◀ ▶ or arrow keys — turn pages · Esc — close
guide.quantx.tips.title: Tips
guide.quantx.tips.1: Accelerator and valve output via the thick nozzle
guide.quantx.tips.2: The valve pumps only while powered
guide.quantx.tips.3: The meter routes only through fibers
item.quantx.matter_goggles.desc: Opens your eyes to the flow of matter. Shift+Right-click to wear.
guide.quantx.desc.book: This guidebook. Crafted from a book and granite dust — in case you lose it.
guide.quantx.desc.goggles: Wear them to see matter prices, the gun's charge and tank levels in the world.
guide.quantx.desc.gun: Hold RMB on a block to break it down into matter. Shift+RMB on a materializer transfers your stock.
guide.quantx.desc.materializers: Assemble items from matter using punch cards. Higher tier — bigger tank and faster assembly.
guide.quantx.desc.network: Fiber carries matter between blocks. Accelerators push it forward; valves and meters control the flow.
guide.quantx.desc.packs: Worn in the gear slot left of the chestplate — expands the gun's tank.
guide.quantx.desc.resources: Granite dust, plates and frames — the base of every QuantX machine. Dust drops from granite.
guide.quantx.desc.storages: Tanks for storing matter. Higher tier — bigger capacity.
guide.quantx.toc.hint: Click a row to jump to the chapter
